source.label: Wizards event coverage, Eternal Weekend 2014: Vintage Top 8 Decklists

notes.text: Players: the coverage text says 341; the round 9 standings have 321 rows, and mtgtop8 also gives 321.
Seeds are the round 9 (final Swiss) standings.

Wizards coverage names the winner (Mark Tocco) and finalist (Dario Moreno) but not the losing semifinalists. Harry Corvese and Ryan Eberhart as 3-4 are from mtgtop8; they fit the seeded bracket (Moreno, seed 8, beat Chang then the winner of Corvese-Glackin; Tocco, seed 7, beat Tran then the winner of Griffin-Eberhart).
mtgtop8 dates this event 26/08/14 instead of 26/10/14.
The decklist page heads this list with the player name only. The archetype is from his Top 8 profile ("Temur Delver"); mtgtop8 calls it Canadian Threshold.
